language.title: Choose your language
language.body: SafeRoute shows the app and writes its reports and spoken warnings in this language. You can change it later.
language.age: SafeRoute is for people aged 18 and older.
language.tagline: Like the Pyit Taing Htaung doll, we help you stay on your feet.
language.heroA11y: SafeRoute, with the Pyit Taing Htaung doll

countries.fromBody: This shows the right hotlines first.

check.title: Check before you go
check.body: Show us a job ad, a message or a link.

doll.title: Tap the doll
doll.body: It checks your screen in any app.

warn.title: Warn your family
warn.body: Send a warning to people you trust.

sharing.title: Help others: share anonymous scam patterns
sharing.body: When a check looks risky, SafeRoute can share its pattern so other people may get a warning sooner. This is optional.
sharing.p1: No screenshots and no message text. Only a short pattern is kept.
sharing.p2: Names and other personal details are removed first.
sharing.p3: Phone numbers and accounts are kept only as one-way codes that cannot be turned back into the number.
sharing.p4: Shared patterns are deleted after 90 days.
sharing.note: You can change this at any time in Settings.

without.heading: Without an account, you can:
without.check: Check job offers, messages, links and pictures
without.voice: Talk with the doll by voice
without.doll: Use the doll on your screen (Android)
without.call: Call hotlines and share a warning

with.heading: With an account, you also get:
with.warn: Send them a ready-made warning in one tap
with.restore: Get your checks and contacts back on a new phone
